strings.lang.intro: Kua tūnohia ngā reo matua. Tikiake tōu reo mō ngā whakamāoritanga katoa ā-ipurangi-kore — ngā whakaahuatanga, ngā pakiwaitara me ērā atu.
strings.lang.failed: I rahua te tikiake. Tirohia tō hononga, ka whakamātau anō.
strings.settings.units.desc: Me pēhea te whakaatu i ngā tawhiti.
strings.settings.night.desc: Ko te whero hōhonu ka tiaki i ngā kamo kua rērētia ki te pōuriuri — he iti ake te pānga o te whero ki te kite pō, ā ka tū tonu te rangi e tiaho ana.
strings.settings.night.auto.desc: Ka whero aunoa i ngā wā o te pō ka pouri te rangi.
strings.settings.location.desc: Ko tēhea wāhi ka tatau ai te rangi.
strings.settings.location.cityNone: Kāore i kitea — kei roto i te rārangi ā-taputapu ngā tāone nui e 5,300 pea, nō reira kua ngaro ngā tāone iti ake.
strings.settings.location.cityNearest: Kōwhiritia te tāone nui e tino tata ana: i roto i te ~50 km he rite tonu te rangi.
strings.settings.location.cityGps: Rānei whakamahia te GPS — ka kitea e tō pūrere te wāhi tika, i runga tonu i te pūrere
strings.pro.freeCore: Ka noho utukore tonu te kaupapa matua — kāmera, Rā, Marama me ngā aorangi 7 katoa. Ka whakawhānui noa a Pro i te rārangi rawa me te tāpiri i ētahi atu taputapu.
strings.pro.lifetimeDesc: Hoko kotahi. Kāore he wā mutunga — e kore rawa e pau, e kore hoki e whakahoutia.
strings.pro.notRenewing: Kāore e whakahoutia — ka mutu te urunga {date}
strings.settings.haptics.desc: Ooriori ina rakaina ki te whāinga.
strings.settings.speech.desc: Ka pānuitia te whāinga me ngā aratohu ā-reo — mō te whakamahi ā-ringa-kore me ngā kaimātakitaki.
strings.settings.fov.desc: Tautuhia māmā kia hāngai ai ngā rārangi aho whetu me ngā ara amiorangi ki te rangi tūturu.
strings.settings.about.credits: I hangaia ki te astronomy-engine, satellite.js me Celestrak.

strings.sat.desc.iss: Te hanganga nohoanga tāngata nui rawa atu i te mokowā. Ka noho tonu tētahi ohu kaihōpara mokowā ki runga, ā, ka takahuri i te Ao i ia 92 meneti. Ko ia tonu te tohu tino kanapa e whakawhiti ana i te rangi pō.
strings.sat.desc.css: Te teihana mokowā o Haina, kua nohoia mai i te 2021. He iti ake i te Teihana Mokowā o te Ao, engari i te wā pai, ka tata kanapa rite.
strings.sat.desc.hst: He karu-whetū mokowā i whakarewahia i te 1990 nāna i huri te mea e mōhiotia ana e tātou mō te ao tōtaka. I pupuri whakaahua o ngā huinga whetū tino tawhiti, ā, i āwhina ki te ine i te tere o te whakawhānuitanga o te ao tōtaka.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: He amiorangi whakamātau nā NASA, he rā rā tōna tata ki te 80 m², e akina ana noa e te pēhanga o te mārama rā. Nā tōna rā piata ka kanapa ia mō tōna rahi.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: He amiorangi mātakitaki Ao nō Uropi, rite ki te rahi o te pahi. I ngaro te whakapā ki a ia i te 2012, ā, mai i tērā wā kua noho ia ki te ōkiritanga hei tētahi o ngā kongakonga para mokowā nui rawa atu.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Te raupapa amiorangi whakawhitiwhiti o Iharaira. Kei te teitei tata ki te 36,000 km rātou, nā reira ka āhua kore nekeneke i tētahi wāhi o te rangi. Kāore e taea te kite mā te karu noa, engari ka tohu te taupānga ki tō rātou ahunga.
strings.sat.desc.eros: He amiorangi whakaahua tino mārama nō Iharaira e whakahaerehia ana e ImageSat, i whakarewahia i te 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: He amiorangi rangahau nō Iharaira-Wīwī i whakarewahia i te 2017 nāna i pupuri whakaahua o te tupu otaota me te whenua pāmu hei aroturuki i ngā panonitanga taiao.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: He amiorangi huarere e rere ana i runga i ngā poli. Ka pupuri whakaahua ia o ngā kapua, ngā tūpuhi, me ngā pāmahana, ā, ka whāngai āna raraunga ki ngā matapae huarere.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: He amiorangi e pupuri whakaahua ana o te mata o te Ao — ngā ngahere, ngā tāone, ngā moana, me te hukapapa — hei aroturuki i te āhua o tō rātou panoni i te roanga o te wā.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: He amiorangi i hangaia hei ako i te mokowā, i te Ao rānei. Kāore ētahi o ēnei e mahi ana, engari ka noho tonu ki te amiotanga.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: He karu-whetū mokowā e mātaki ana i te ao tōtaka mai i runga ake i te kōhauhau, e horomia ana te nuinga o te mārama e tae mai ana i te mokowā.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: He amiorangi e kawe ana i te pouaka whakaata, te ipurangi, me ngā waea. Ko te nuinga o ēnei ka rere teitei rawa atu, nā reira he iti noa e kitea mā te karu noa.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Tētahi o ngā mano amiorangi Starlink a SpaceX, e tuku ana i te ipurangi mai i te mokowā. Ka rere iti rātou, nā reira he māmā ki te kite, ā, i ētahi wā ka rere i te rārangi roa, kotahi i muri i tēnā.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Te wāhanga o runga o tētahi rākete, nāna i kawe tētahi amiorangi ki tōna amiotanga, ā, i noho tonu ia anō ki reira. He nui ēnei mea, ā, he kanapa i te nuinga o te wā, nā reira he māmā noa ki te kite.
strings.identify.proMore: Ka tautuhi anō te Pro i ngā whetū, huinga whetū, me ngā mea mokowā hōhonu katoa.
strings.moon.asSeen: He tipoki e kitea ana mai i tō wāhi · {t}
strings.tonight.hint: Ngā wā e tū ana tēnā me tēnā mea i runga i te pae i tēnei pō · pāwhiri kia whakaahu ai te kāmera ki reira
